lane: Blum-Mitchell two-view co-training; View A geophysical/subsurface only, View B DEM surface plus in-stack radiometric band(s); disagreement is the discovery signal
primary_hypothesis: A-only directional variogram anisotropy on bands 2,13,15,17,7,16 yields transferable lineated geophysical predictions where a disjoint DEM/radiometric View B abstains; test strict view sufficiency and block-level OOF negative-error independence before any pseudo-label exchange

views.A_feature_transform: directional semivariogram anisotropy and log mean semivariance, eight integer directions, lags 1,2,3,4,6 px, Gaussian sigma 3 px; no raw A bands
views.B_feature_source: work/r2/features FeatureStore manifest view_B only: raw bands 6/12/19 and template DEM curvature/slope/local-residual columns; radiometric identity for band 6 remains a metadata conflict, with prior byte-based total-count comparison recorded as provisional
views.feature_cache: work/r2/features; shared gems52.structural.FeatureStore; structural builder output is label-free and erodes 36 px support
views.input_provenance: registry/data_manifest.json hash-pinned owner mirrors; byte integrity is not organizer authentication

holdout.paired_cluster_bootstrap: 20 km physical blocks, percentile 95% CI, 1000 draws
holdout.negative_definition: held-out catalogue-zero proxy, not verified fault absence

allowed_exchange: only if both views have mean holdout OOF AUC >=0.60 and the measured spatial-block negative-error diagnostic is defined, has at least 20 blocks, and max absolute Pearson/Spearman correlation <0.60; otherwise stop without pseudo-labeling

submission.uniqueness: gems52.gates.uniqueness_report over all accessible local priors; exclude self-copies by basename and decoded SHA
submission.lane: literal gate before placement on the surface and after placement on final dots; any >0.90 rank correlation or >0.70 directed <=3 px dot proximity is DUPLICATE/STOP
submission.not_union: compare emitted support against each single-view placement and equal-budget max(A,B) union placement
submission.weekly_slot_promotion: separate selector step; not performed by this experiment

planned_experiments: feature canary + per-view fit + spatial-block independence/sufficiency gates
conditional one-round whole-segment pseudo exchange and matched-budget holdout, only if both gates pass

verdict_rule: negative unless a predeclared same-fold holdout comparison exceeds all comparable baselines and every validator/lane/uniqueness/not-union check passes; no score projections and no competition upload slot
external_data: none used; GDR 1391 2 m temperature excluded because bytes could not be retrieved from the allowlisted sandbox
